always_encrypted.description: Default value: true. Set to false if TLS is not required when using an SSH tunnel.

authentication_method.description: The authentication method used to connect to your cluster.

capture_deletes.description: Whether to capture hard deletes, meaning source documents removed from the index. Set to false to skip hard-delete detection, which may improve connector performance for sources that do not hard-delete documents. This does not affect source-level soft-delete fields; those fields sync as ordinary document updates. If you re-enable delete capture later, resync the affected tables to rebuild an accurate delete baseline. Default value: true.

connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect using an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect using an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect using an SSH tunnel.

password.description: ESM key for the user's password.

user.description: ESM key for the user name.
